def need(test, message):

def sha(raw):

         and Path(value).is_absolute() and ".." not in Path(value).parts,

def identity(path):
    for item in (path.parent, *path.parent.parents):
        need(stat.S_ISDIR(item.lstat().st_mode), "unaliased directory ancestry required")
    info = path.lstat()
    need(stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode) and info.st_nlink == 1, "unaliased regular input required")
    return (info.st_dev, info.st_ino, info.st_size, info.st_mtime_ns, info.st_ctime_ns)

    need(type(value) is dict and set(value) == {"path", "bytes", "sha256"}, "closed file reference required")

    fd = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW | os.O_NONBLOCK)
    digest, chunks, total = hashlib.sha256(), [], 0
    try:
        initial = os.fstat(fd)
        actual = (initial.st_dev, initial.st_ino, initial.st_size, initial.st_mtime_ns, initial.st_ctime_ns)
        need(actual == before and initial.st_nlink == 1, "opened input identity differs")
        while True:
            chunk = os.read(fd, 65536)
            if not chunk:
                break
            total += len(chunk)
            need(total <= ref["bytes"], "input grew beyond bound")
            digest.update(chunk)
            if retain:
                chunks.append(chunk)
        final = os.fstat(fd)
        actual = (final.st_dev, final.st_ino, final.st_size, final.st_mtime_ns, final.st_ctime_ns)
        need(actual == before and final.st_nlink == 1, "input descriptor changed")
    finally:

    need(total == ref["bytes"] and digest.hexdigest() == ref["sha256"]
         and identity(path) == before, "input bytes or identity changed")

    need(old is None or old == (ref, before), "one input has conflicting identities")
